title: campanula carpatica f. subpilosa
intro: Campanula carpatica f. subpilosa, commonly known as Bellflower, is a flowering plant species used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, and its therapeutic actions, such as acting as an antimicrobial and antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Campanula carpatica f. subpilosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
